text: 华虹宏力：公司及全资子公司上海华虹宏力拟与无锡锡虹国芯二期、华芯鼎新、国开公司共同对无锡华虹宏力三期半导体有限公司进行增资，建设月产能约为5.5万片/月的12英寸特色工艺晶圆代工产线。本次交易前，标的公司工商登记的注册资本为人民币668万元，通过本次交易使标的公司注册资本达到41.7亿美元。
text_en: Hua Hong Semiconductor: The company and its wholly-owned subsidiary Shanghai Hua Hong propose to jointly increase capital in Wuxi Hua Hong Phase III Semiconductor Co., Ltd. with Wuxi Xihong Guoxin Phase II, Huaxin Dingxin, and China Development Bank, to build a 12-inch specialty process wafer foundry line with a monthly capacity of approximately 55,000 wafers. Prior to this transaction, the target company's registered capital was RMB 6.68 million; after the transaction, it will reach USD 4.17 billion.
